column2: 中古英语 overall ← 古英语 ofer eall（遍及全部），由 over ＋ all 复合而成
column3: taking everything into account
column5: The overall cost came to nine hundred pounds.|Her overall performance improved during the term.
column6: covering the whole rather than a part – 罩住全体而非局部
column7: 总的：把各部分合起来算|整体的：着眼于全体而非单项
column8: 一张图表把全年各月的柱子一并框进同一个方框里

column2: 由 over- ＋ coat 构成
column3: a long warm coat worn over other clothes
column5: He buttoned his overcoat before going outside.|A heavy overcoat hung beside the door.
column6: a coat worn over the rest – 套在其余衣服外面的那件
column8: 门口衣钩上挂着一件长及膝下的厚外衣，里面还套着西装

column2: 中古英语 overcomen ← 古英语 ofercuman，由 over- ＋ come 构成
column3: to succeed in dealing with a difficulty
column5: She overcame her fear of deep water.|They overcame every obstacle on the route.
column6: to come over an obstacle and past it – 翻过阻碍并越过去
column7: 克服：把挡路的困难越过去|战胜：压过对手取得上风
column8: 登山者翻过挡路的巨石，继续朝上走

column2: 中古英语 overflowen ← 古英语 oferflōwan，由 over- ＋ flow 构成
column3: to flow over the edge of a container
column5: The river overflowed after three days of rain.|Milk overflowed the pan onto the stove.
column6: to flow beyond the edge that holds it – 越过容器边缘流出去
column7: 溢出：液体越过边沿流出|漫出：向四周铺开流出
column8: 水从盆沿一直漫到地面，盆里还在不停注水

column2: 中古英语 owerheved ← 古英语 oferhēafod，由 over- ＋ head 构成
column3: situated above the level of the head
column5: An overhead cable crossed the narrow street.|The overhead lights flickered twice tonight.
column6: positioned above the head – 位置高过头部
column7: 头顶的：正在头的上方|高架的：架在高处越过下方
column8: 车间天花板下方悬着一根横梁，工人从下面走过

column2: 中古英语 overheren ← 古英语 oferhīeran，由 over- ＋ hear 构成
column3: to hear something said without being meant to
column5: I overheard them planning a surprise party.|She overheard part of the phone call.
column6: to catch words that travel over to you – 话越过来被你接到
column8: 隔间那侧的谈话传过挡板，这边的人停下笔

column2: 由 over ＋ lap 构成
column3: to cover part of the same area as something else
column5: The two schedules overlap on Tuesday morning.|Their duties overlap in several areas.
column6: to lie partly over another – 一部分压在另一物上
column7: 重叠：两者有一段压在一起|部分相同：范围有一块彼此共用
column8: 两张纸边缘压在一起，压住的那条带子颜色更深

column2: 中古英语 overloken，由 over ＋ look 构成
column3: to fail to notice something, or to have a view over a place
column5: He overlooked one line in the contract.|Our window overlooks the whole valley.
column6: to look over something without taking it in – 目光越过而没接住
column7: 忽视：目光越过去没看进眼里|俯瞰：从高处往下把整片看在眼里
column8: 检查者视线扫过表格，掠过中间那一栏没停

column2: 由 over- ＋ pass 构成
column3: a road or bridge that crosses above another road
column5: Traffic crawled beneath the concrete overpass.|They built an overpass near the station.
column6: a way that passes over another – 从另一条路上方跨过的通道
column7: 立交桥：上下分层交叉的桥|天桥：架高供跨越的桥
column8: 一条车道从另一条车道上方横跨过去，两层车流互不相碰

column2: 由更早的 oversea ＋ -s 构成
column3: in or from a country across the sea
column5: She spent three years working overseas.|Overseas orders rose sharply last quarter.
column6: on the far side of the sea – 在海的另一侧
column7: 海外的：来自或位于海那边的|在国外：身处本国之外
column8: 货箱贴着远方港口的标签，吊车正把它移上远洋船

column2: 中古英语 overtaken，替换了更早的 overnimen ← 古英语 oferniman（突然逮住），由 over ＋ take 构成
column3: to catch up with and pass someone ahead
column5: A lorry overtook us on the hill.|China overtook them in total output.
column6: to come up level and then get past – 追平之后再越到前面
column7: 超过：越到前面去|赶上：追到与之并齐
column8: 后面的车驶到并排位置，随后驶到前方

column2: 中古英语 overthrowen，由 over ＋ throw 构成
column3: to remove a ruler or government by force
column5: Rebels overthrew the government within a week.|The regime was overthrown that same winter.
column6: to throw something over from its position – 把立着的东西掀倒
column7: 推翻：把当权者从位置上掀下来|颠覆：从根本上把既有秩序掀翻
column8: 广场上的立像被绳索拉倒，底座空了出来

column2: 由 over- ＋ time 构成
column3: extra hours worked beyond the normal schedule
column5: He worked overtime three nights this week.|Overtime pay was added to her wages.
column6: hours running beyond the set time – 超出规定时段的那部分时间
column7: 加班：在规定时段之外继续做|超时：越过了限定的时长
column8: 办公楼只剩一间亮灯，墙上钟已过下班点两小时

column2: 中古英语 overturnen，由 over ＋ turn 构成
column3: to turn something upside down, or to reverse a decision
column5: The boat overturned in rough water.|A higher court overturned the earlier ruling.
column6: to turn something over from its position – 把原来的朝向整个翻过来
column7: 翻转：把物体上下颠倒过来|撤销：把先前的决定整个翻掉
column8: 小船底朝上浮在水面，桨浮在旁边

column2: 中古英语 overwhelmen，由 over ＋ whelm 构成
column3: to affect someone so strongly that they cannot cope
column5: The team was overwhelmed by the news.|Requests overwhelmed the small support desk.
column6: to cover something completely by force – 整个盖住、压过去
column7: 压倒：力量上完全盖过对方|使不知所措：多到让人应付不来
column8: 巨浪从头顶盖下来，小船整个没进水里

column2: 由 overwhelm ＋ -ing 构成
column3: so great that it cannot be resisted
column5: The proposal passed by an overwhelming majority.|She felt an overwhelming urge to leave.
column6: too great in force to be resisted – 力量大到无法抵挡
column7: 压倒性的：数量或力量上完全占优|难以抗拒的：强到让人挡不住
column8: 计票板上一侧的条几乎填满整栏，另一侧只剩一小截

column2: 古英语 āgen（自己的），本为 āgan 的过去分词 ← 原始日耳曼语 *aiganaz ← 原始印欧语 *h₂eyḱ-（持有）
column3: to have something as a possession
column5: They own two small shops in town.|She wrote the letter in her own hand.
column6: holding something as what belongs to oneself – 把某物作为自身所属持有
column7: 拥有：某物归自己所有|自己的：属于本人而非他人的
column8: 房产证上写着一个名字，钥匙就在那人手里

column2: 中古英语 padell（小铲）← 中世纪拉丁语 padela，更早词源不明；另一支「拍水」义 16 世纪起见于记载
column3: a short oar used with both hands, or to move a boat with it
column5: He dipped the paddle into the water.|They paddled across the lake at dawn.
column6: a short blade pushed through water – 在水里推动的短叶片
column7: 桨：手持的短柄板叶|划水：用它推水使船前行
column8: 双手握着一根短柄板叶，交替在水里向后推

column2: 借自中古法语 page ← 拉丁语 pāgina（书页）；另有「侍童」一义 ← 古法语 page，或经意大利语 paggio ← 中世纪拉丁语 pagius（仆人）
column3: one side of a sheet in a book or magazine
column5: Turn to page ninety in your book.|The page loaded slowly on my phone.
column6: one sheet face in a bound set – 装订成册中的一个纸面
column7: 页：书刊里的一个纸面|网页：屏幕上相当于一页的一屏内容
column8: 手指捏住纸的右下角，抬起后露出下面一张

column2: 中古英语 paleys ← 古法语 palais ← 拉丁语 palātium，得名于罗马七丘之一的帕拉丁丘，共和国贵族与后来的皇帝在那里营建华宅
column3: a large grand house where a ruler lives
column5: Tourists queued outside the royal palace.|The palace gates opened at nine.
column6: the grand residence of a ruler – 统治者的宏大居所
column8: 石阶尽头是高大列柱与镀金门扇，卫兵分立两侧

column2: 中古英语 pamflet／pamphilet ← 中古法语 Pamphilet，是 12 世纪拉丁语情诗 Pamphilus, seu de amore 的俗称；该诗以薄册广为流传，遂以此名指称整类薄册
column3: a small thin book giving information or arguing a case
column5: Volunteers handed out pamphlets outside the station.|The pamphlet explained the new rules clearly.
column6: a thin unbound booklet for spreading a message – 用来散发主张的薄册子
column8: 几十张薄纸对折订在一起，有人在路口一张张递给过路人

column2: 由 pan-（全）＋ 希腊语 horama（所见景象）构成，1792 年由画家 Robert Barker 造出
column3: a wide unbroken view of a large area
column5: The hilltop offers a stunning panorama.|A panorama of the city covered one wall.
column6: everything visible in one sweep – 一眼扫过所能见的全部
column8: 站在山脊上转身一周，四面的山谷连成不断的一条

column2: 借自法语 parachute，由 para-（防）＋ chute（下落）构成
column3: a large piece of cloth that slows a fall through the air
column5: His parachute opened just above the trees.|They packed each parachute with great care.
column6: cloth spread to check a fall – 张开布面拦住下落
column8: 一大片圆形布面在空中张满，下方吊着一个人缓缓下沉

column2: 中古英语 paradygme ← 晚期拉丁语 paradīgma ← 希腊语 paradeigma（示范、样式），由 para-（旁）＋ deiknumi（指示）构成
column3: a typical example or pattern that others follow
column5: This case became a paradigm for later studies.|The discovery shifted the whole paradigm.
column6: a pattern held up beside others to copy – 摆在旁边供比照的样式
column7: 范例：拿来当榜样的那一个|范式：一整套通行的做法框架
column8: 墙上挂着一张标准样张，下面几张都照它的格式排

column2: 借自中古法语 paradoxe ← 拉丁语 paradoxum ← 希腊语 paradoxos（出乎意料的），由 para-（背离）＋ doxa（公认看法）构成
column3: a statement that seems to contradict itself yet may be true
column5: The result presents an interesting paradox.|He enjoyed pointing out this old paradox.
column6: a claim running against accepted sense – 与公认道理相抵的说法
column7: 悖论：自身推出相反结论的论断|矛盾之说：听着说不通却未必错的说法
column8: 一张纸上两行字各自成立，却指向相反的结论

column2: 借自中古法语 parallèle 与拉丁语 parallēlus ← 希腊语 parallēlos，由 para-（旁）＋ allēlos（彼此）构成
column3: running side by side at a constant distance
column5: The two roads run parallel for miles.|Their careers followed parallel paths.
column6: side by side without ever meeting – 并排延伸而永不相交
column7: 平行的：两线间距不变永不相交|类似的：两事走势彼此对应
column8: 铁轨两条钢条一直向远处延伸，间距始终不变

column2: 部分借自法语 paralyser，部分由 paralysie ＋ -ize 在英语内部构成；paralysie ← 古法语 ← 希腊语 paralusis（一侧松脱）
column3: to make someone unable to move, or to bring activity to a stop
column5: The injury paralyzed his left arm.|A strike paralyzed the city transport system.
column6: to take away the power to move – 使失去活动能力
column7: 使瘫痪：让身体失去活动能力|使停顿：让运转中的事整个停住
column8: 电闸一拉，整条流水线的机械同时停住不动

column2: 中古法语 parasite ← 拉丁语 parasitus ← 希腊语 parasitos（在别人桌边吃饭的人），由 para-（旁）＋ sitos（食物）构成
column3: an organism that lives on another and takes its food
column5: The parasite weakens its host over time.|Doctors treated the patient for intestinal parasites.
column6: a feeder living beside its host – 靠在宿主旁边取食的生物
column7: 寄生虫：附在他体上取食的动物|寄生物：泛指靠他体存活的生物
column8: 细小生物附在叶片背面，从叶脉里抽取汁液

column2: 中古英语 parcel ← 古法语 parcelle（小块、小部分）← 晚期拉丁语 particella，为拉丁语 particula（小粒）的指小形，更上一层是 pars（部分）
column3: something wrapped in paper for sending or carrying
column5: The parcel arrived two days late.|She signed for a heavy parcel.
column6: a small part wrapped up as one – 包成一件的小块东西
column7: 包裹：包扎起来待寄送的一件|小块：从整体分出的一小部分
column8: 牛皮纸裹住方形物件，四角用麻绳十字捆牢

column2: 中古英语 parent ← 盎格鲁诺曼语与中古法语 parent ← 拉丁语 parēns（生育者），为 parere（生育）的现在分词
column3: a mother or father of a child
column5: Both parents attended the school meeting.|Each parent received a printed report.
column6: the one who brings forth offspring – 生出下一代的那一方
column7: 父母：生育并养育子女的人|亲代：生物学上产生下一代的那一代
column8: 成年人牵着孩子的手走在前面，孩子仰头看他
